predecessors.name: Republic of China
predecessors.text: the whole Republic of China of Cliopatria's 1914-1915 shape, turned into a monarchy

successors.name: Republic of China
successors.text: the whole of the empire's land less the provinces that had declared independence; 'the Republic of China was restored' on 23 March 1916 under Yuan, then Li Yuanhong from 6 June

rulers.name: Hongxian Emperor (Yuan Shikai)
rulers.title: Great Emperor of the Chinese Empire

ledger.x: 1916: Yuan Shikai becomes emperor of China.
1916: Yunnan is gone before the Empire begins.
1916: Yuan Shikai gives up the throne on 22 March, 83 days into the reign.

wars.name: National Protection War
wars.outcome: Yuan's defeat: the monarchy was abandoned on 22 March 1916, Yuan died on 6 June and the war was ended on 14 July 1916; the seceded provinces came under local warlords.

certainty.note: The empire's limits are the provinces of the Republic (administrative lines); the frontiers with Tibet and Outer Mongolia, which the pages do not treat, are not sharp.
